identificationRemarks: @silversea_starsong by the maxilla reaching to beyond the anterior margin of the pupil this is not *Butis butis* (which has shorter maxillae reaching barely to below anterior margin of eye). Both *humeralis* and *audebertae* have maxillae reaching to anterior margin of pupil (or if not, at least 1/3 distance under eye) (disregarding Taiwan, Guangdong, Fujian populations of *Butis humeralis* for simplicity sake). In this case by body depth at first dorsal fin and general coloration this should be *humeralis*, though a more reliable method to ID will be to take a dorsal shot of the head and count interorbital and predorsal scales I don’t think *Butis butis* has been recorded from Bangladesh yet

And notice that there are no other sightings of Pacific Trumpetfish from Oman on iNaturalist.
